title: 1.4 Historical Issues and Contributors
description: Historical Issues and Contributors concepts and applications. Hard level, 20 questions.

questions.question: A student says modern physics simply threw away classical physics. Which textbook-based correction is most precise?
options: Many classical laws were modified during the twentieth century
Every classical law was declared outdated here in the textbook
Classical physics stopped being taught as well in the textbook
Modern physics studies only biology in physics in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Many classical laws were modified during the twentieth century

questions.question: An inventor builds a device with a magnet and a coil. Which historical figure first demonstrated the key principle in 1821?
A physics class studies heat, work and the first law of thermodynamics. Which contributor should be introduced first?
A class compares the achievements of Newton and Einstein. Which contrast is best supported by the unit?
options: Newton founded classical mechanics; Einstein transformed mechanics through relativity
Newton developed relativity; Einstein wrote the laws of motion as well in experiments
Both discovered radioactivity in class in the textbook of this subject in experiments
Both built the first electric generator in this topic in the textbook of this subject
questions.correctAnswer: Newton founded classical mechanics; Einstein transformed mechanics through relativity

questions.question: A student confuses Faraday and Joule. Which pair of clues separates them correctly?
options: Faraday - generator; Joule - heat and work
Faraday - heat and work; Joule - generator
questions.correctAnswer: Faraday - generator; Joule - heat and work

questions.question: A report discusses how gravity explains both a falling apple and the motion of planets. Which scientist made that connection?
A report discusses how a magnetic field can produce an electric current. Which scientist made that discovery?
A museum label mentions polonium and radium. Which scientist is being honored?
A timeline places relativity, quantum mechanics and nuclear physics in the early twentieth century. Which scientist fits several of these entries?
A student says Galileo proved that mass changes the rate of falling. Which experiment from the unit should be cited?
options: The leaning-tower experiment with falling objects
The magnet and current experiment in the textbook
The heat-and-work experiment here in the textbook
The radioactivity experiment here in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: The leaning-tower experiment with falling objects

questions.question: Which sequence of contributors matches the textbook order from classical foundations to modern physics?
A physics club wants to study a historical issue and a contributor. Which pairing fits the unit?
options: The rise of modern physics and Albert Einstein
The classification of species and Charles Darwin
The invention of writing and Hammurabi
The discovery of oxygen and Joseph Priestley
questions.correctAnswer: The rise of modern physics and Albert Einstein

questions.question: Which statement about the first electric generator is accurate?
options: Faraday produced it after converting magnetic force into electrical force
Newton built it while studying gravitation in the textbook in experiments
Joule built it while studying heat as well in the textbook in experiments
Einstein built it while studying relativity in this topic in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Faraday produced it after converting magnetic force into electrical force

questions.question: A quiz asks which contributor is associated with both heat and the first law of thermodynamics. Which answer is correct?
A quiz asks which contributor is associated with the law of refraction. Which answer is correct?
A quiz asks which contributor is associated with fluid flow and pressure. Which answer is correct?
A quiz asks which contributor is associated with interference experiments in light. Which answer is correct?
A student claims only twentieth-century scientists matter in physics. Which fact from the unit is the best response?
options: Newton, Faraday and Joule built the foundations used later
There were no scientists before 1900 still in the textbook
classical physics has no modern relevance now for students
Physics began with Einstein in the textbook in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Newton, Faraday and Joule built the foundations used later

questions.question: A poster pairs a scientist with a phrase. Which pairing is correct?
options: Curie - mother of modern nuclear physics now
Faraday - father of relativity in this topic
Joule - inventor of the telescope in physics
Newton - discoverer of radium in experiments
questions.correctAnswer: Curie - mother of modern nuclear physics now

questions.question: Which statement captures the units view of historical contributors?
options: Physics advanced through many scientists working in different periods
Physics was completed by one scientist in the textbook in experiments
Physics discoveries have no practical effects as well in the textbook
Physics history belongs to biology classes in physics in the textbook
questions.correctAnswer: Physics advanced through many scientists working in different periods
